__comment: samograph.dev observability dashboard (SPEC §5.11). Config-as-code: import into Grafana against a Prometheus datasource that scrapes the app `/metrics` endpoint (packages/shared/observe). The funnel panel and the W1-activation stat read the metrics the activation-funnel aggregator exports (the funnel series carries BOTH a `stage` and a `method` label since SPEC amendment S5-1 item 7 / issue #222 — there is deliberately no unlabelled series, so use `sum by (stage)` for the blend); the lower row reads the §5.11 counters. Hosted provisioning (datasource, Grafana instance) is intentionally out of scope (#87).
title: samograph.dev — Activation funnel & observability

panels.title: W1 activation (target ≥ 0.5)
panels.description: THE single v1 success metric (§9): signups who paste a link, get the bot admitted (in_call_recording), and watch ≥ 30 s of stream.

panels.title: Activation funnel (cumulative by stage)
panels.description: signup → auth completed → call created → first transcript line → 30 s of stream (§5.11). Split by signup method (S5-1 item 7): magic_link vs google.

panels.title: W1 activation by signup method (§9 re-baselining)
panels.description: For the first full week after Google ships, the ≥ 0.5 §9 target is judged against method="magic_link"; the blended number above is reported but NOT targeted (SPEC amendment S5-1 item 7). One-click signup raises the denominator faster than the numerator, so the headline metric can FALL while the product improves.

panels.title: Sign-in & magic-link health (S5-1 item 7)
panels.description: auth_identity_linked_total counts Google identities SILENTLY attached to an already-existing account (S5-1 item 5) — the event the user only learns about from the one-time notification email.
